description: Use Claude Haiku 5.5 as the main model, the fastest and lowest-cost option for simple, well-scoped tasks. Pinned to the full model ID (claude-haiku-5-5), so it stays on Haiku 5.5 instead of following the 'haiku' alias. Requires Claude Code v2.1.293+; on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry use your provider's model name instead.
